# Module `lune_ui_core::widgets::label`

[API reference](../../INDEX.md) / parent [`lune_ui_core::widgets`](../widgets.md)

Label text: the [`label`](label.md#fn.label) spec helper for the widgets, and [`LabelRole`](label.md#enum.LabelRole) with [`Ui::label`](../ui.md#method.Ui.label) for
static text (`label.md`). Static text takes no input and animates nothing.
